name: Trisannabrücke
kurzbeschreibung: Spectacular 87-metre-high railway arch bridge of the Arlbergbahn spanning the Trisanna gorge near Pians, crowned by medieval Schloss Wiesberg.
preis: Free of charge (viewpoints and valley trails publicly accessible without fee)
beschreibung:
Overview

The majestic Trisannabrücke at the entrance to the Paznaun Valley near Pians and Tobadill is celebrated as an engineering masterpiece of the historic Arlberg railway. Constructed between 1883 and 1884 to establish rail transit across the Arlberg, the daring structure spans the wild Trisanna gorge with a magnificent 120-metre steel arch at a breathtaking height of 87 metres. Perched directly beside the eastern bridgehead on a rocky promontory sits picturesque Schloss Wiesberg, dating back to the 13th century. The striking juxtaposition of modern steel architecture, a medieval castle fortress, and the rugged, forested mountain flanks of the Lechtal Alps makes this scene one of Tyrol's most celebrated and photographed landscape vistas.

Route & Requirements

The bridge and castle can be experienced either via a relaxed scenic valley hike or from roadway viewing stops. From Pians or Landeck, a scenic, well-marked hiking path leads alongside the rushing Sanna River up towards Schloss Wiesberg (roughly 1.5 to 2 hours' walking time, 150 metres elevation gain). The trail follows compacted gravel tracks and woodland paths, requiring only standard physical fitness and comfortable walking shoes. Bringing a good camera is strongly recommended to capture the stunning angles. The railway bridge itself is strictly reserved for train operations and may not be entered under any circumstances. Private Schloss Wiesberg can be admired from the outside. Excellent vantage points are found along the old Paznaun valley road and the river basin below.

Visit & Arrival

The bridge structure and castle exterior are freely accessible and viewable all year round at any time. Drivers reach the location via the Inntal motorway A12 or Arlberg expressway S16 to the Pians exit, following the B188 Silvretta highway toward Paznaun to designated parking bays near Schloss Wiesberg (free parking). By public transport, take train services to Landeck-Zams station and board VVT bus lines 260 (towards Ischgl/Galtür) or 4242, stopping at Pians Schloss Wiesberg right near the primary lookout.

Tips

Check the Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) timetable before visiting: watching a modern red-and-white Railjet express glide gracefully across the bridge at a height of nearly 90 metres provides a truly spectacular photo opportunity. Combine your stop with a traditional meal at a cosy Tyrolean inn in nearby Pians.
